title: R4 run-command job (draft, rev-2, not frozen)
description: Draft, rev-2, not frozen. Design-only request envelope for a future hyvv /v1 run-command job; no launcher.py change exists.
$comment: Field refusals named in description fields match section 3 of docs/design/r4-run-command.md. Authorization gate refusals are not schema-testable.

kind.description: request_kind_invalid: top-level kind is required and must be the exact run-command string.

attempt_id.description: attempt_id_invalid: optional attempt id, otherwise minted by make_handler.do_POST.

brief.description: brief_not_object: the brief must be a JSON object; brief_field_not_allowed covers any unlisted brief property.

objective.description: objective_required: a non-empty objective is required.

project.description: project_invalid: enrolled project slug; project_not_enrolled is checked by gate 3.

source_rev.description: source_rev_invalid: a 40- or 64-hex revision used when seeding the project.

purpose.description: purpose_invalid: slug-shaped purpose; purpose_not_allowed is checked by gate 4.

command.description: command_invalid: non-empty command; command_too_long exceeds the provisional 2000-char cap in N4.

budget.description: budget_not_object: budget must be an object with only timeout_s.

timeout_s.description: budget_timeout_s_invalid: required integer in 10..7200; budget_exceeds_policy_max is checked by gate 5.

commands.description: command_list_not_allowed: use kind=check for command lists.

security_profile.description: security_profile_not_allowed: the matched policy entry supplies the profile.

model.description: model_field_not_allowed: run-command has no model route.

tier.description: model_field_not_allowed: run-command has no model route.

mode.description: model_field_not_allowed: run-command has no model route.

verify_of.description: verify_of_not_allowed: verify_of applies to opencode attempts only.

model.description: request_field_not_allowed: no model at top level.

tier.description: request_field_not_allowed: no tier at top level.

mode.description: request_field_not_allowed: no mode at top level.

project.description: request_field_not_allowed: top-level project is a route-preview convenience only.
